༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu badz+ra ya/ dpal ldan sdom pa nag po spyod pa'i lugs/ / gtso bor byas pa'i bde mchog lha tshogs rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas brnyes byed pa'i/ /cho ga bshad phyir : [ rab tu ] gus pas :mdud [ 'dud ] 'di la gnyis/ rnam bzhag mdor bstan/ lag len rgya sa : [ rgyas ] par bshad pa'o/ /dang po :yi [ ni ] / 'di yi dkyil chog du he ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo'i/ /lha rnams phyi dang nang gis mchod/ /lha yi grangs bzhin blo ldan pas| |mdzes pa'i gos kyang dbul bar bya/ /'khor lo bsgyur dang :dpa'o [ dpa' bo ] :ne [ ni ] / /rang byung me tog gis mchod cing*/ /lho phyogs sgo nas dag pa yis/ /gdong 'di dag par bkrus nas so/ /zhes pa rnams kyis phyi nang gi mchod pa spyi dang*/ bye brag gos dang nang mchod dang*/ /'bul ba'i phyogs dang spyod lam bstan zhing*/ /spos snod dag ni brgyad po dang*/ /mar me'i sdong bu de mnyam bya/ /til mar chen pos rab tu sbar/ /spos ni lnga po sngon 'gro ba'i| |me tog sna tshogs 'chang ba dang*/ /sna tshogs chang dang khu ba dang*/ /rol mo dag gis rab bkang zhing*/ /sna tshogs zhal zas lha bshos dang*/ sna tshogs rnal 'byor ma spang na/ /dri bzang me tog sna tshogs ldan/ /sna tshogs pa yi glu len zhing*/ /sna tshogs [ pa yi ] gar bzang byed/ /bkra shis sgra ni sna tshogs so// zhes pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i dngos po tsam bshad de bzhin du rgyud mngon :rjod [ brjod ] nas/ wa pas kyang ni mar me bya/ dpa' bo chen pos bdug spos dang*/ /lha bshos klad pas bya ba ste/ /dri chen rdo rje chu yis dri/ /zhes pas rdzas dang*/ bum pa bzang po dag gis ste/ /ar+gha'i snod ni thod pa ste/ /mchod yon rus pa'i phye ma'o/ /zhes pas snod/ mchod yon gyi rdzas bshad do/ /rgyud sder| zhing skyes lhan cig skyes lha mo/ / gnas skyes rnal 'byor ma de bzhin/ / rigs skyes ma mo skyes lha mo/ /mthar skyes mi snang mkha' spyod ma/

/tha ma dang ni mchog de nyid/ /bar ma sna tshogs de bzhin du/ /sa spyod dang ni sum bcu ma/ / sa 'og spyod ma 'og na gnas/ /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang*/ /m-i 'am ci mo dri za mo/ /lha mo thams cad dngos grub dang*/ /gzhan yang bde gshegs bsam pa can| |dkon mchog gsum la sngon dga' ba/ /thams cad phyi yi dkyil 'khor du| |sna tshogs glu dang nyer spyod pas/ /rtag tu glu dang gar byed cing*/ / sna tshogs :nyis [ rgyan ] kyis spras pa yi/ /lha mos mkha' 'gro gtso bo mchod// ces pas mchod mkhan dang*/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gnas :gams [ goms ] pas| |lha yi snying po sgom byed pa/ de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o/ /zhes pas de kho na nyid dang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnam bshad la/ bde mchog gi gzhung phal cher du chu gnyis las mi 'byung yang*/ bi bhu tis chu bzhi bshad cing*/ /mi thub zla :las [ bas ] / /pi waṃ ma dang gling bu ma/ /rnga zlum ma dang rdza rnga ma/ bzhad mo sgeg mo glu gar ma/ /me tog ma dang spos 'chang ma/ /mar me ma dang dri chab ma/ /me long ma dang ro 'dzin ma/ /reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /ces pas rig ma bcu drug bshad cing*/ /de dag kyang*/ a bha ya dang jo bo rje la sogs pas snying kha'i hūm̐ las sprul/ bi bhu tis hūm̐ las byung ba'i ā li bcu drug las skyed/ la ba pa dang me dri ba snyoms 'jug gi sbyor 'tshams nas spro'o/ /go rims kyang*/ /rtag pa'i rdo rje dang*/ bi bhu tis chu dang nyer spyod kyi sngon du rig ma mdzad kyang*/ sa skya pa dang pu rangs pa sogs bzlog nas mdzad pa ltar phyis kyi mkhas pa dag kyang bzhed/ de rjes 'dod yon lngas mchod pa yang gsang sngags spyi dang khyad par bla med la thob cing*/ go rims bu ston gyi rin chen sna bdun gyi mjug du mdzad mod sngon du rigs shing*/

/sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs kyang mi thob pa med la/ rtsa brgyud nas gos zung dang rgyal mtshan sna tshogs bshad pa'ang dgos so/ /de bzhin du thun mong ma yin pa'i he ru ka'i chas drug dang rol cha sogs kyang thob bo/ /de ltar na| chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ /rig ma 'dod yon rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags gdugs 'phan gos/ /thun mong min rnams phyi mchod do/ /nang dang gsang mchod bstod bzlas gtor/ /smon lam bzang gsol bkra shis so// gnyis pa la bsham pa dang sgrub pa dang 'bul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mdun skyed rgyas pa yod na de'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la mchod pa dgos zhing*/ med na| maṇ+ḍal mdun skyed du grags pa bsham par bya ste/ rang bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i sgo gsum sbyang ba dang phung sogs byin rlabs tsam byas nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas g.yon pa'i 'theb srin gyis blangs ste/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis phyogs bzhi dang rang la'ang gtor nas go cha drug bkod de bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas sa phyogs gtsang ma khru gang gi tshad yan tshad ji tsam rigs pa'i rgya la byi dor legs par byas la der lag pa g.yon pa bzhag ste zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod cing*/ chang dang ba byung dang bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang kyis sbang ba'i chus g.yon skor du khye ma me ra gru bzhi'i rnams par byung la/ de'i dbus su lag pa g.yon pa bzhag ste/ /pu dza lags pa'i yi ger nyer bzhi brjod/ oṃ sti tha/ u pa pī tha/ /k+ṣe tra u pa k+ṣe tra/ tshan+dho ha/ u pa tshan+dhi ha/ me lā pa ka u pa me lā pa ka sh+mā sha ni/ u pa sh+mā ni/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa rab dga' la sogs pa sa bcu'i rang bzhin du grub par gyur/ de nas gzhung rnams su mi 'byung yang*/ phyag len me tog gam tshom bu dgod par mdzad pas/ de'i gnas nges pa'i phyir du tshangs zur steng du 'khor lo lnga'i thig rang ris btab la/

/bdud rtsi lnga dang :phyar [ sbyar ] ba'i dri bzang kyis thig le dang de dag sbyar ba'i 'bru bzang pos tshom bu dgod par bya'o/ /de'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la ras dkar po la sogs pa'i gzhi'am| me tog sim la bkram pa'i steng du/ g.yon skor gyis thod pa'am/ / dung chos sam/ ting phor gang rnyed kyi chu bzhi'am/ yang na gsum dang de dag gi mdun du bzed zhal stong pa gsum bsham/ de nas phyi nang gi nyer spyod gang 'byor| |'dod yon dang rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'i gzugs ri mor bris pa sogs gang brnyed/ /bla re dang gdugs 'phan/ gos zur lha grangs dang mnyam pa sogs gang bshoms/ he ru ka'i chas drug /spyi dang khyad par gyi rol mo la sogs pa rnams bkod pa gang mdzes 'bru gsum dang rang rang gi sngags mang du bzlas zhing bshom par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni de'i mdun du rang nyid phyi nang gi khrus gang :'grus [ grub ] byas stan bde ba la 'dug nas mdun skyed bsgrub par bya ste/ /'di'i tshul la/ rtag pa'i rdo rje dang bi bhu ti/ /rten sgrub thabs bzhin skyed pa'i zla ba dkar dmar gyi dbus su rang gi snying kha nas hūm̐ yig spros/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes :pi [ pa'i ] dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bkug ste de ma : [ la ] thim pa :po [ yongs ] su gyur pa las lha re gnyis go cha dang bcas pa skyed nas mchod/ me tri pa/ hūm̐ las dam tshig pa'i rten dang brten pa rdzogs par skyed go cha dang rigs bdag kyang rang chas su byas nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la mchod rten bcug nas rims kyis gsal btab ste mchod/ sa skya pa bdag :skyed [ bskyed ] dang cha 'dra ba'i mngon byang lnga bskyed byas nas mchod pa mdzad mod kyi/ :lo i [ lū hi ] pa la ni bdag bskyed dang lnga bar mngon byang lnga las rten dang brten pa gcig char bskyed pa dang*/ /dril bu pa la phyi dkyil med pa'i lus dkyil nyid dang/

'di la ni/ phyi nang gnyis ka bdag bskyed ji bzhin dgos te/ 'di'i mdun bskyed kyi thad du de nyid bcu bzhi bshad pa'i phyir| |des na rgya bod phal cher gyis/ rten phyi dkyil sa bon las bskyed nas brten pa mngon byang lnga las gcig car bskyed pa sogs kyi rnam bzhag rnams ni 'thad pa ma mthong ngo/ /de'i phyir 'di la ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs nas bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub pa shin du legs par mthong ngo*/ /'o na 'di'i bdag mdun gyi zhal phyag cung zad mi mtshungs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis phyag bzhi mar mdun skyed la bshad pa sogs ci yin zhe na/ /de dag ni bdag skyed la'ang gdam ngag can du mdzad par gsol/ dpe na rtswa ku sha sngo ljang rtse mo ma nyams pa :bas [ bsangs ] zhing sbyangs la g.yon nas brtsam ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir ku sha gnyis gnyis :sa [ snga ] ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bas non pa dgram zhing de phang thog mar lag tu bzung ste/ oṃ i mi ku sha shu bha de bya pa bi tra bra h+ma de ba tā/ ratā tra ya ra ta hi/ pri thī wi dza tata la gad+bhaḥ sarba bigh+nān ma la shān+ti kurban+tu swasti swāhā/ zhes pa tshar gnyis dang*/ aṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams :gakhyed [ dag byed ] yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*/ /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa tshar gcig gis bgegs bsrung*/ bgegs sbyang ba dang srig pa sbyang ba bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan me long la 'char du bcug la ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus dkyil 'khor dang mchod rdzas kyi ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs bar gyur/ /zhal bzhi pa dang khaṇ+ḍa ro te bzlas/ /rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ ri bo tshang tshing :slan [ sman ] ljongs dang*// zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim zhes pa'i bar gyi mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom/

rang nyid gtso bo las byed ba'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas par gyur nas bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgor gnas par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin brlabs ni mngon rtogs bzhin gyi sdus pa'am/:phro [ sprau ] na/zhal bzhi pas bgegs :bas [ bsangs| ] swa bhā was dri ma sbyangs/ /mchod rdzas rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las :la [ a ] las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ /rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ byed las rang gzhan gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byas pas phyi nang kun du gang par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ āḥ hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ /pā d+yaṃ/ /ā+eñtsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ badz+ra :puṣ+pa [ puṣ+pe ] / dhū pe/ gan+de/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+da/ gan+dha ra sa yar+sha āḥ/ hūm̐/ sngags re re'ang brgya rtsa'am nyi shu rtsa re'am/ /bdun nam/ /gsum :lags [ legs ] pa bzla zhing rang rang gi phyag rgya spyi dang mthun pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ / gsum pa la sngon du lha gsal gdab pa'i phyir du sngags bstod tshang bar bya/ de rjes chu ba ni/ bya rgyud legs grub dang*/ rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba/ / dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bston [ pa ] 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ces pa'i/ dkyil chog rin chen 'bar ba nas bshad pa/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi/ sogs sam/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa/ lhung bzed chen por 'tshal chen legs par sbyangs/ dung chen phye ma sbrang chen me tog bcas [ par ] / dgyes chen skyed byed mtsho chen yon chab 'bul/ brtse chen gyis bzhes bde chen :rtsal

[ stsal ] du gsol/ oṃ āhri pra wa ḍa pat+ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha rūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ āñtsa :gsang [ bsang ] gtor rnams dang*/ /pa d+yaṃ/ āñtsa ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa lnga sbya ro/ nyer spyod na/ lha mi [ yi ] me tog dam pa 'di/ /sogs sam/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge / sogs sam/ mthong ba'i mod la bde ster rigs ldan ma/ /spyi dang khyad par me tog mchod sprin thogs/ /nyer spyod lha mos mkha' ngos bkang ste 'bul/ /zag med bde bas nyin mtshan 'da' bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ wa ra ba ṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du 'don pa :bkang [ spos ] ste zhal zas kyi bar du sbyor/ yang na/ /mngon brjod kyi/ zhing skyes zhes sogs tshang ma'am /sna tshogs glu dang sogs la/ sngags brgya la dbul lo/ /rol mo ni/ gzugs mdzes gdangs snyan lha rdzas :bsil [ sil ] snyan kun/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho/ /phra rags dag gi rol mo ji snyed pa/ /mkha' dang mnyam pas rgyal ba mnyes gyur cig |shap+ta rig ma bcu drug ni/ /bsdu na mi thub zla ba'i tshig kyang gong du bshad pa'am| 'bring du na/ rgyal ba'i rgyal ba mchod phyir legs sprul ba/ /lha mos lha yi mchod sprin rgyan gos thogs/ /pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga la/ /bde ster rig ma'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /yo gi nī bh+ya/ oṃ badz+ra bi ṇi/ wi she/ /mri taṃ ge/ mu re dze rnams la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar/ /de bzhin du/ rkang pa gsum pa la/ bzhad ma sgeg mo glu ma gar mkhan ma/ /zhes dang*/ me tog bdug pa mar me dri mchog ma// zhes dang*/ gzugs dang ro ma reg bya chos dbyings ma/ /zhes dang*/ sngags/ ra s+ye| lā s+ye/ gī d+ya/ nri t+ye/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī pi/ gan+dhe/ rū sa/ badz+ri/ ra sa spar+sha/ dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tha ma bzhi la badz+ra snga ma med/ rgyas par byed na/

rkang pa gsum pa la/ pi waṃ sgra yis rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*/ /ces dang*/ gling bu'i/ rnga zlum/ rdza rnga'i/ bzhad pa'i nyis kyis sgeg pa'i/ glu yi dbyangs kyis/ gar gyi ro yi/ me tog mchog gis/ bdud spos/ snang gsal*/ dri yi/ gzugs kyi/ ro yi| reg bya'i/ chos dbyings mchog gis rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*/ /zhes sbyar ro| 'dod yon ni/ :gas [ gsang ] 'dus dang gur las gsung pa/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /de nyid bcom 'das sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par nang mdzad gtso/ /lha rnams spyan la 'bul bar bya/ /de bzhin du mi bskyod rdo rje/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ pad+ma gar dbang*/ don yod rdo rje gtso dang*/ snyan| shangs/ ljags/ lus/ rtu pa badz+ri shap+da/ gan+dha ra sa spar+sha badz+ri sbyar/ yang na| :rnaman [ dman ] 'bring mchog gi gzugs kun 'od gsal zhugs/ rnams kun mchog ldan gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /dpal yas rgyal ba'i spyan gyi bde ba skyed/ /rab mdzes gzugs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig

de bzhin du/ sgra'i| dri'i/ ro'i reg bya'i rdo rje ma/ zhes sogs/ gdangs snyan pa'i sgra/ yid 'ong dri'i/ tshim byed ro yi/ 'jam mnyen reg bya'i/ zhes sbyor/ rin chen sna bdun ni/ lha rdzas kun gyi :bskrun [ bsgrun ] du med pa'i nor/ /dpal yas dge legs bye bas bsgrub pa'i rdzas/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid bla na med| |'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /tsakra rat+na/ de bzhin du| nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang po/ rta mchog khyim bdag rnams dang ma ṇi| s+t+ri/ pu ru sha/ ga dza/ a sha /gri ha pa ti/ sbyar ro/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad ni| gzugs kyi lha mos phul ba'i bkra shis :s+dzas [ rdzas ] / dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long 'di/ /phul bas nam mkha' mnyam pa'i lun can kun/ / phun tshogs bkra shis dpal la spyod par shog /a dar sha= lha yi dbang pos= g.yas 'khyil chos sgra snyan par sgrog pa'i dung= sa bsrungs dbang pos= nyon mongs dug gsum 'joms pa'i :gi hi [ 'gi wang ] 'di= legs skyes bu mos= stong gsum rtsi bcud kun gyi snying po zho= /sa yi lha mos= chos kun dbang du bsdud pa'i li khri 'di= tshang pa chen pos= rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bsdud ba'i bil :ba [ wa ] 'di= rtsa 'tshong khye'u= rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe 'phel dur ba'i rtsa= gsang ba'i bdag pos= bgegs kyi bar chad kun 'joms yungs dkar 'di= zhes sbyar/ shang kha gi haṃ da dhi/ li :gri [ khri ] bil wa/ dur ba/ aṣ+ta tra bo maṅga la kun la sbyar ro/ /a da sha me long*/ zho/ 'gi wang/ dur ba/ bil wa rnams la da dhi/ big wat+ta 'bring no shang kha dung dang li khri/ par+sha paṃ yungs dkar rnams so| |spar+she rnams sbyar ro/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ zag med rgyal ba'i ye shes rnam 'phrul las/ /mtha' med 'gro ba'i dge legs gter gyur pa/ /dri med mkha' ngos bkra shis dpal be 'di/ /'gyur med bde ba'i slad du bzhes su gsol/ / 'khor lo/

pad+ma/ rgyal mtshan/ bum pa/ gdugs mdzes/ dung dkar| gser nya/ sngags watwa la/ tsakra/ pad+ma/ dh+wa dza/ ka la sha tsha gra/ shi kha/ ro hi ta sbyar ro/ /gdugs 'phan ni/ gtso ba'i 'khor yug sogs/ ma hā pu dza sbyor| gos ni/ lta bas mi ngoms sna tshogs mdangs bkra zhing*/ /'dod yon gtso bo reg bya'i yon tan ldan/ /ka tsa lin+da lha rdzas gos kyi mchog /nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig sogs dang*/ was+t+ra/ rgyan ni/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i mtshan dpe'i sogs thun mong ba dang thun mong min pa ni/ rigs drug rang bzhin phyin drug rnam par dag /sngags drug ngo bo dpal po'i phyag rgya drug /tshogs drug dad pas phul bas 'gro drug gi /skyon drug zad pa'i phyin drug rdzogs par shog /ni raṃ bu ṣaṭa a laṃ ka ra/ thal chen spangs ba dpal mo phyag rgya lnga/ 'khor lo rna rgyan mgul rgyan gdub bu dang*/ /'og pag ces bya rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rgyan mchog phul ba'i dug lnga'i skyon zad shog ni raṃ pañtsa a laṃ ka ra/ gti mug zad byed zhag gi zo ris dang*/ /zhe sdang 'joms byed thal chen tshom bu dang*/ 'dod chags gnyen po rag+ta'i thig le yis/ rgyan mchog phul bas dregs pa'i dgra 'joms shog /maṃ sa bha smin k+ṣañtsa/ /bdag med don ston rgyal ba'i thugs rgyud skul/ /mkha' 'gro kun bsdud ma rungs klad : [ pa ] 'gems/ /cang te'u rkang gling gsang pa'i rnge chung sgra/ phul bas sgeg pa'i dngos grub rdzogs par shog /gu h+ya shap+da/ rig 'dzin btung snod mtshan ldan thod dngos dang*/ /rnal 'byor lag cha kha ṭāṃ gri gug dang*/ /:ro lugs [ re lde'u ] gdan dang bgo ba stag gzigs gos/ chas bzhi phul bas sku bzhi 'grub par shog /ka pā lā di zhes sbyar ro/ /nang mchod mngon rtogs bzhin dang*| rgyas par sa lugs kyi bde mchog gis brgyud rims chen mo'i bla ma la'ang dbul lo/ /gsang mchod gnas bzhi dang mkha' gsang byin brlabs kyang mngon rtogs bzhin byas la/

de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis/ / dkyil 'khor pa rnams lhan skyes bdag 'dzin dang*/ /stong nyid mnyam par sbyar ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rtag tu rol ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig/tat+t+wa tā sbyor/ bstod pa ni/ gtso bor rkang brgyad kyi sngags gnyis dag par rjod/ de gnyis bod skad du bsgyur ba 'dra sngon chad byung 'dug pa rnams skad dod ma tshang ba dang ma 'byor bar snang bas/ oṃ/ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug phyag 'tshal| |hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du sbyar ste/ kun nas bskal pa chen po'i me yi 'od| |ral pa'i cod pan mi bzad pa dang ldan/ /mche ba brtsigs pa bsgyur zhing 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /stong phrag phyag ni 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /stag gi :lugs [ pags ] pa'i nam bza' 'dzin pa can/ /dud chen mun nag dang 'dra'i sku la 'dud/ /ces dang*/ oṃ| bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ /'phra ma mi pham 'jig rten gsum yum rig dbang ma/ /rdo rje che brnyes 'byung po thams cad 'jigs pa mo| |rdo rje'i gdan la mi pham dbang mdzad spyan ldan ma/ khro gtum gtsigs pas g.yo ba'i dug rnams skems pa mo/ /bdud rnams 'joms shing 'ges pas pha rol las rgyal ma/ rnam par rgyal ba rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed ma/ / phag mo sbyor chen mkha' 'gro 'dod dbang ma la 'dud/ /de bzhin du/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i sngags sam/ de bod skad du kho bos bsgyur ba yod pas kyang stod/ spro na/ bu'i mchod 'phreng na bris pa'i/ rgyal ba dus mtha' sogs dang*/ dpal chos kyi grags pa'i rgyun chags dang*/ de ri ka dang*/ rin chen rdo rje dang*/ bhu ba ri pas mdzad pa'i bstod pas kyang stod/ de dag ma grub na'ang*/ nag po dkyil chog gi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i stabs na/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba bzhugs/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/

/kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras rtsol ba/ /gnyis med gnyis med sar gnas pa/ /rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma lang bcas/ /dam le che la bu ltos shig /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa/ /rab gtum la sogs yang dag sbyor/ /'dir dag thugs kyi sprul pa ste| |'khor lo mkha' la spyod pas bstod/ /myu gu can la sogs pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad gnyis su med/ /gsung ni rnam dag ngo bo yis/ /mi yi 'jig rten khyab par gnas/ /stobs po che sogs chags kun gyis : [ rjes chags ] // sku yi sprul pa bshad pa ste/ /grub pas sa 'og gnas pa'o// he ru ka pa sogs 'khor lo/ g.yon pas :mkhyud [ 'khyud ] cing nu ma 'dzin/ /sku gsum zhes bya'i sprul pa ste/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'o/ khwa gdong la sogs ma mo brgyad| khro bo rnam rgyal sogs brgyad pa'o/ /sgyu ma'i ngar brgyal yang dag stan// byang chub so bdun sprul pa'o/ /mkha' la spyod dang sa la spyod/ /sa 'og spyod dang ma mo brgyad/ /mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad gnyis ste/ /lha rnams de nyid bstan par bya| zhes pa'i/ bu ltos shig dang*/ bstan par bya/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /la phyag 'tshal zhes sgyur ro/ /de nas/ bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ 'khor 'das ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog /ces pa'i bar du bhi ri pa'i rgyun bshags don yid la :mnags [ mnag ] pa'i sgo nas sdig bshags nas smon lam gdab pa'i bar bya'o/ /de tsam mi nus na/ dā ri ka pas/ thog ma med dus 'khor ba nas/ /chags sogs rtog pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ / sdig bgyis mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yis/ /nyer bsdus 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams tshogs ni ma lus la/ /rtag par bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /rdo rje ye shes thugs chud nas/ /shing dan drung na bzhugs gyur pa'i/

/'gro la nyer :bste [ ste ] thub dbang rnams/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur ste/ /mgon po dbyings su gshegs bzhed la/ /sems can sdug bsngal bral bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /bdag ni thub dbang ma gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas sngags sogs chos rnams dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcas/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas bgyi zhing*/ /dam tshig thams cad :bskyad [ bskyed ] ba dang*| |sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /grol bar bdag gis sgrub par bgyi/ (/bsten sogs :de [ dge ] ba de dag gis/) /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gyur nas/ /'gro la yongs su grol byed shog /zhes brjod/ /de nas sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs kyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung la/ :na [ nang ] par sngar langs sems bdag nyid/ /ma lus pas ni byas nas kyang*/ /gsung ba bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*/ /lus dang srog la ltos med pa| |dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ / nyin re bzhin du bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /:rgan [ dgun ] zla 'bring po nas brtsam ste/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas/ /tshe bcu la ni de rang mchod// :chad [ chang ] dang sha sogs gang ci'ang ru/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs| |thams cad gnyis med :pha [ pa ] na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod| |theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can dag la'ang rgyab mi phyogs| |'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das las bar mi 'gro/ / dpa' bo rnam 'byor ma kun la/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'gom par [ bya ] mi bya'o/ /dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis/ tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/

/bud med thams cad mthong ba nas/ /g.yon nas lan gsum skor bya zhing*/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*/ lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ khyod la bdag ni bu yin te/ / ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byung na yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ / gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /bslab pa blangs nas sngon 'gro bas/ /danā da la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung*| |dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba'i sbas pa'i yid/ / spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i dam tshig rnams ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsrung :snyi [ snyam ] du yid la bya'o| |de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa dang sngags la sogs pa mngon rtogs bzhin bya la der kha 'phangs pa'i yum gyi rkang brgyad ni/ oṃ sa mo bha ga wa ste badz+ra wa ra hi baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du mgor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ gnyis dang phaṭa/ stong chen bla ma'i bka' drin las/ gang shar stong par rtogs pa'i bzung rnam nyid| |bde chen lha skur shar ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /'khor lo sdom par gyis (dgyes)pa bskyed pa'i thabs/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i dge dang rang gzhan gyi| |dge tshogs ma lus gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ /'gro kun thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /mchog [ lam ] rdo rje theg pas bgrod par shog / dal 'byor 'di ni shin du gsol [ g.yo ba ] dang*/ 'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rtogs dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog de sgrub par shog/ de yang sngags pas snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni brtan po dang*/ /gtong [ stong ] pa la sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /zab mo'i tshul dag la ni lhag par mos/ /dpal ldan sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga :yig [ yi ] /rang gi dbang bskur phun [ gsum ] tshogs ldan zhing*/

/cho ga bzhin du rjes gnang thob nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas rang sngags mnyes byed shog /ri bo tshang tshing brlan lbangs [ sbangs ] chu chen ngogs| |gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod chen po sogs/ / :gyir [ gyer ] dgos gnas dang yo byad kun tshogs par/ / dpal ldan sdom pa tshul bzhin sgrub par shog /sgo gsum sbyangs shing phud sogs byin brlabs nas/ /zhing mchog spyan sngar bsod nams tshogs kun bsgrubs/ /rnam thar gsum gyis spros kun 'od gsal du/ /bsdus pas 'chi srid chos skur bsgyur bar shog /de nas :brlung [ rlung ] sems chos phra n+wa da'i gzugs/ /mkha' ngos legs shar snod bcud zhing sbyong ba'i/ /rgyu yi rnal 'byor rdzogs mthar de nyid kyang*/ /de zhugs bar do longs skur 'khyer ba shog /de dag zhu ba'i thig le 'od gsal zhugs| |rgyal ba'i glus bskul mtha' las 'gro ba'i slad/ / sprul skur bzhes pa'i yab yum yongs rdzogs pas/ /rgyu mthun bsnyen pa chung ngu mthar phyin shog / drug gnyis go cha mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /yan lag drug gi nyes skyon mtha' dag sbyangs/ /rdo rje'i skye med don kun 'jug nus swo/ /rnam smin nyer sgrub chung ngu mthar phyin shog /shin du phra ba'i sgo gsum mi shigs pa/ / rgyal ba kun gyi rdo rje rnam gsum du/ /myur du bsgyur ba'i thabs mkhas bla med kyis/ /byed 'bras sgrub pa chung ngu mthar phyin shog /sems dpa' gsum brtseg ye shes dgug gzhug dang*/ /dbang skur rgyas btab rjes chags rnal 'byor gyis/ /dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin mthar son nas/ /bral 'bras sgrub chen chung ngu mthar phyin shog |gdod nas grub pa'i longs sprul mtha' dag bkug /:mdzad [ mdzod ] pur thim nas byin brlabs snyoms zhugs pas/ /mngal bskyed lus dkyil mtha' dag gsal rdzogs grub/ /mngal skyed phyi/ kun rdzogs mngal skyed 'phros/ phyi dkyil la mkhod bsnyen chen rdzogs par shog

go cha rdo rje gsum rdzogs nyer bsgrub dang*/ dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab sgrub pa rdzogs/ mchod bstod bzlas pas sgrub chen che mthar phyin/ /thun 'tshams spyod mchog yongs su rdzogs par shog /rgyal mchog rnam gnyis rnal 'byor rdzogs par shog |chos sku sngon btang bsrung 'khor dngos gzhir bsdus/ /longs sku'i lam 'khyer don gnyis khyad par can/ /sprul skur bsnyen sgrub bzhi ldan ting 'dzin gsum| |zhabs lugs la brten skyed rims mthar phyin shog /dpyid thig gsang ba'i de nyid snying po bsdud/ /o la ba ti sdom bshad phyag chen thig /rtsa dang dam tshig don dang mngon rtogs dang*/ /rnal 'byor phyag rgya'i sdom ste rdzogs rim gzhung*/ /sdom pa drug gi nyams len kun 'dus pa/ /rgyud dang sngags dang ye shes gsang ba yi/ /rim pa bzhi yis 'od gsal bde chen las/ /zab gsal sgyu lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de yang sbyar la/ /ār+ya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te bu d+ye sha ra/ sarba bhu ya ā wa te ma tā badz+ri ṇi/ badz+ra ā pa ni a pa ra dzi te waṃ shaṃ ka ri ne tra/ /bh+ra ma ṇi bi sha ṇi sho sha ṇi kro dha ka ra li ni/ tra sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe dang ni pa ra dza ye/ bi dza ya dza m+bha ni tam+bha ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra wa ra hi mahā yo gi kā me shwa ri kha ge /yang na thog ma'i mgor oṃ dang*/ tha ma'i 'jug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'ang rung ngo*/ /rtsa sngags ni/ rkang brgyad hūm̐ dang ma spel ba'i mjug tu btags pa 'am ma btags pa'ang ru ste/ tad+ya thā/ pro ta ge sngo targe/ ha ha ha na pra ṇāṃ/ keṃ ki ni kiṃ ki ni/ dhadhā na badz+ra ha stang*/ sha sha ya sho sha bar ya/ badz+ra kha hwa ka sta la dha ri ṇi/ /ma hā si shi ta maṃ sa/ ā pa ni ma' ni ṣ+ya/ aṇ+ra pra bri tags/ paṃ ni dh+ya/ na ra shi ra mā la gran+thi ta dha ri ṇi/ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni ha na ha prā ṇi sarba satwā nī/ ma hā mā sam tshe da ni/ kro dha mūd+dhi diṣ+ta ka rā laṃ ni/

ma hā mu tre/ shī he ru ka de ba s+ya/ agrā ma hi ṣi/ sa ha pra shi re/ sa ha pra ā wa he/ sha ta sa ta pra ā na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dzā s+ya/ /dz+wā la mu khe/ biṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra sho rī re/ badz+ra ā pa ne/ mi li ta/ tsi li ta/ he he/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhū dhū/ /dhu ru dhū ru/ mu ru mu ru// a dwe te| ma hā yo gi ni/ pa ṭhe ta sid dhi/ driṃ dh+waṃ driṃ dh+waṃ/ graṃ graṃ| hī hī hū hū bhī ma ha sa ha sa bī re/ hā hā hī hī hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lo kyang bi nā sha ni/ sha ta sa ha pra ko ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri wa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ siṃ ha ru pe khaḥ ga dza rū pe/ āḥ trai lo kya u de re mu tra me khā le/ gra sa gra sa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī ra dwe te/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hā hā ma hā sā shu mo ha ni yo gi shwa ri te/ ḍa k+ki ni sarba lo ka ni ban+da ni/ pa t+ya pra t+ya ka ri ṇi/ /sarba bhū ta tra sa ni ma hā bī re sa ra ma sid dhe yo gi shwa re phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gtso bor 'byung ba 'di nag po pa la sbyar zhing 'di dang ṭu thad mi mthun pa gcig mngon rjod nas 'byung ba la :lo i

[ lū hi ] pa la sbyar zhes bu ston gsung yang*/ rgya bod kyi yi ge rnams cung zad 'chugapa'i bris nor gyi dbang gis tha :dar [ dad ] du snang :ba' [ ba ] shas ches bas 'dir dag par bcos shing bod skad tshigs bcad du byas :pa'i [ pa ] zur na yod do| |bzlas pa'i mthar lha thams cad la dngos grub blang ba'i phyir du rdo rje glus gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khro bo bde ba dges pa yi/ / bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pas bsten par byed| |bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad ma'i bde| |a la la la la ho/ /dges pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a ī a ā ra lo ho/ rab dges mgon po dges bzhugs mdzad/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba gsol/ dges pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod| |bdag la bde chen bde ba gsol/ /a la la la la ho/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ zhes sogs :yi [ yig ] brgya brjod/ gtor ma yi dam chos skyong*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gang lcogs gtang*/ mdun skyed dang 'brel na phyi rol pa yang btang*/ bdag 'jug sogs blangs/ mthar gtang rag mchod pa bya zhing*/ ma 'brel na/ nang gtor gyi 'jug du mchod bsdus pa byas la/ bsngo ba smon lam bya ste/ rdo rje can zhabs spyir dgos shes bya'i de nyid rig khyad par rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs shes/ rtsa 'khor yi ge rlung la gsal snang thon// sngon 'gro rgyud kyi rims pa rdzogs par shog /lte ba'i aṃ 'bar me :mar [ dmar ] gyen du 'phyur/ /dkyil 'khor kun bsregs kun rtog mun pa sangs// rgyal ba'i bde chen kun bsdus haṃ la thim/ /gyen 'bar sngags kyi rim pa mthar phyin shog /spyi bo'i haṃ khru gnyis mar 'thur du 'babs/ /dkyil 'khor kun sos bde chen nyi ma shar/ /dkar dmar :phrang

[ phreng ] pa'i dpe yi 'od gsal rdzogs| |'thugs 'dzag ye shes rim pa mthar phyin shog /phyi nang srog rtsol sbyor bas rlung sbyangs nas/ /nyi zla dbu mar dbyer med sbar ba las/ /zab gsal gnyis med 'od gsal mthar phyin nas/ /zung 'jug gsang ba'i rim pa mthar phyin shog /ces sogs smon lam spyod dgos legs par bya/ /yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes pa gang*/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /so so skye bor gyur gang dang*/ /nye bar mkho ba med pa dang*// brjed dang shes bzhin ma yin pas/ /cung zad cho ga nyer ma tshang*/ /de dag bkru zhing bzod par mdzod/ ces sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don la gsol ba gdab/ nyer bsdu mngon rtogs bzhin rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa byas la/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yod bsdu ba'i sgrub mchod sbrel na ma bsdus par brtan bzhugs byas la shis rjod rgyas par bya ste/ rab 'byams skye rgu'i dge legs ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mkha' ngos 'gengs pa'i rnam rol mtha' yas kyis/ /shis rjaud dge legs rtsol ba 'di ltar ro/ /dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas spro na thams cad kyi gter mdzod dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam 'phrul/ /chos sku zag med kyi bde stong ye shes byang phyogs :sa [ so ] bdun longs sku sgrib bral gyi rtsa dang thig le lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ sprul sku gang 'dul gyi 'byung lus phra rags gnas gsum mkha' 'gro thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ /de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyis sgrub tshul gtso bor gsal bar mdzad pa gsang bdag phyag rdor lags pa dang*/ dag: [ dbang ] gsum pa'i lam gyis sgrub tshul gtso bor gsal bar mdzad pa dbang phyug :lo i

[ lū hi ] pa lags pa dang*/ dbang gnyis pa'i lam gyis sgrub tshul gtso bor gsal bar mdzad pa grub chen nag po spyod pa lags pa bla ma dam pa bar ma chad par byon pa rnams :khyi [ kyi ] bkra shis dang bde legs kyi 'byor bas khyed cag skye rgu thams cad nyin mtshan du skyong bar gyur cig /sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje 'chang gi dngos/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis/ / sa gsum 'gro la bde mchog dga' ston gyer/ /dus gsum bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir :rtsol [ stsol ] / / rgyal ba khyab bdag de nyid kyi sku yi rnam 'phrul thar pa chen po'i khang bzang na bde ba chen po'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa la rtag tu rol zhing gang la gang 'tshams pa'i phrin las kyis skye rgu lhag par skyong ba lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis lags pa 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rnam par bzhugs pa rnams kyi/ gang sku khro chags gar gyi rnam kun gyis/ /tshar bcod rjes 'dzin phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs/ / sangs rgyas kun mchog bkra shis deng 'dir :rtsol [ stsol ] / /de nyid kyi gsung gi rnam 'phrul la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud mngon brjod :'bul [ 'bum ] pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyud bde mchog nyung ngu*/ khyab byed kyi rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud kun du kha sbyor/ thun mong min pa mngon rtogs kyi rgyu mngon brjod bla ma/ cho ga yi bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro| khyad par gyi bshad rgyud 'byung pa gsum dang kun tu spyod pa/ cha 'thun gyi bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug gi brjod bya rjod byed thams cad kyi/ gang gsung ches zab rtogs dka' rdo rje'i tshig/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i brjod bya rjod byed tshogs/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed rnam dkar lung rtogs dngos/ /dam chos dkon mchog bkra shis deng 'dir :rtsol

[ stsol ] / /de nyid kyi thugs kyi rnam 'phrul/ gnas las skyes pa/ zhing las/ sngags las/ rigs las/ las las skyes pa'i pho nya dang pho nya mo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la brtson pa/ phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad/ phyi nang gi sa bcu'i :spang [ spangs ] rtogs la gnas pa dge 'dun dkon mchog tu bzhugs pa thams cad kyi/ gang thugs brtse ba'i byin rlabs nyin mtshan du/ legs par zhugs pas lam 'dir rab brtson zhigs/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub legs par thob/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog bkra shis deng 'dir :rtsol [ stsol ] / /mdor na dpal ldan sdom pa'i phun tshogs kyis/ /mngon par mtho zhing srid zhi'i dgra :'jom [ bcom ] pas/ /ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis dge legs kun/ / nyin mtshan kun du rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs shis brjod bya/ kha zas kyi dus su/ :'khad [ phud ] mchod byed na/ kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe :bo [ bong ] nas mthe chung gi bar dang 'dus pa'i sen mo rnams la yab kyi go cha drug /:'thil [ mthil ] du pad ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i dbus dang phyogs g.yon skor du yum gyi go cha drug lha sngags gang rung bkod/ lag pa'i :sol [ bol ] la lha re gnyis gzugs brnyan ltar bsgom/ sa sogs khams lnga la ltung byed la sogs lnga bkod la/ g.yas pa pa'i :'theb [ mtheb ] srin gyi nang mchod zas kyis mchod/ nyer spyod dang rig mas kyang mchod/ /skang brgyad :skyis [ kyis ] bstod/ kha zas kyi phyed sgong gzhan du bzhag ste thag na longs spyod che/ phyed rang gis bza' zhing lag gal gos pa'i zas rnams g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te hūm̐ ā/ oṃ zhes brjod cing rang gi snying mgrin dpral bar byung nas lag pa'i lha tshogs kyang rang la stim/ rdzas lhag ma rnams lag pas phan tshun mnyes nas :gdang

[ gdong ] dang yan lag :pa [ la ] byugs bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de ni lag pa mchod pa'i cho ga yin la/ lag pas mchod pa ni lag pa sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab pas maṇ+ḍal la chang gi chos 'byung snol ba'i dbus su zlum po bris/ gnas nyer bzhi'i sa bon brjod nas dar los shing*/ dkyil 'khor skad cig bsgoms pa la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ /mthar rang la bsdu/ /maṇ+ḍal la gos pa'i chang gnas gsum du byug pa'i bar bya'o/ /dpal ldan sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ / mnyes byed mchod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /prañdza ratā'i prañdzās bsgrubs/ dge bas [ mgon der ] 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /dge bar gyur cig /shes rab rin chen gyi shes rab kyi bsgrub/ /'di ni mkhar lung pa yis dkrol/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/bde mchog nag po spyod pa'i sgrub thabs snying po bde 'jug -PAGE 238--PAGE 237--PAGE 236-
